scope: Four pinned Kotlin persistence/presentation repositories; code-object dispositions and storage migration boundaries

rows.observedLegacyBehavior: BLOCKING decodes as NOTE; one session per family may span routes; disabled IDs can be session-memory-only when save_parameters is false; report text is generated from current states.
rows.migrationBoundary: Preserve item and family identity before any state transfer; an enum or saved flag is not evidence that a check is mandatory or technically approved.

storedFields: records -> string set of seven URL-safe Base64 UTF-8 fields separated by |
rows.observedLegacyBehavior: Loads by descending timestamp; add deduplicates by timestamp and retains at most 100; clearProfile removes one profile's records. Comments describe local storage and do not grant data-transfer authority.
rows.migrationBoundary: This is diagnostic-session history, separate from calculation HistoryRecord; timestamp collisions and malformed records require explicit migration policy.
Display choices do not authorize advanced emergency actions or alter publication status.

rows.observedLegacyBehavior: Recording an entry moves its ID to the front, removes duplicate IDs and keeps at most six; this is a recent-items list, not a calculation record.
rows.migrationBoundary: Map entry IDs and family keys explicitly before transfer; never assume a recent ID resolves to a published runtime object.
